traceability.notes: All acceptance criteria and requirements from docs/stories/010.2-DEV-MULTI-STORY-SUPPORT.story.md are fully implemented and verified by tests. The codebase supports the @supports annotation format, validates each requirement ID against its specific story file with clear, story-path-inclusive error messages, maintains backward compatibility with existing @story/@req annotations, allows mixed usage of both styles in the same file/function, scopes requirement IDs per story file, and is documented in the user-facing migration guide and API reference. Multiple rule and helper modules are explicitly annotated to this story, and the corresponding Jest tests for valid-annotation-format, valid-req-reference, require-story-annotation, and require-req-annotation exercise single-story, multi-story, and mixed-annotation scenarios. The latest test run shows all these suites passing, so the story is considered PASSED.
